title: Verification record can classify a clean but off-pin submodule as clean: engram_verification_record.rs checks only for empty change arrays
outcome: A source in which any gitlink's checked-out commit differs from its recorded pin is never classified as clean by TermAl's verification record, under both the legacy and the new source_id shape (Engram w-d895ea3ac77c).
acceptance: engram_verification_record.rs (cleanliness classification, currently around line 136) treats a source as clean only when no staged, unstaged or untracked change exists AND no gitlink is off its recorded pin; an off-pin child commit makes the source not clean under both source_id shapes.

A behaviour test that fails before the fix builds a repository with a clean submodule checked out at a commit other than its recorded pin, and shows that the verification record does not classify it as clean; it passes after the fix, with no wall-clock thresholds.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
